entities.name: Benzylic acetate deacetylation
observations: The reactant contains an Ar–CH2–O–C(=O)CH3 acetoxymethyl group and the product contains the corresponding Ar–CH2–OH group, consistent with ester saponification/deacetylation.
The exact supplied reactant string is not parseable as valid SMILES/SELFIES; assignment is based on the matched product and reaction record.

entities.name: LiOH aqueous MeOH cyclic ether
observations: A directly matching reaction record uses lithium hydroxide, water, methanol, and a cyclic ether solvent reported as 1,3-dioxolane/THF-like, yielding the deacetylated alcohol.
Likely practical description: LiOH·H2O in aqueous MeOH/THF or aqueous MeOH/1,3-dioxolane, followed by aqueous workup.
